purpose: Validate and time the optional wave scheduler without changing the TRNet scientific update rule
sampling: cached seed 1 epoch 0 actual training queries
procedure: One complete training-prefix replay per encoder/backend, BCE forward and backward for each batch, zero_grad and memory detach each batch, no optimizer update; identical initial state_dict restored before each backend
timing_limitations: Single timing per backend in sequential-then-wave order; other research processes were active. Timings are indicative, not a controlled throughput benchmark. Frozen parameters isolate scheduling parity from optimizer trajectory roundoff.

parity_test.coverage: all six encoders and all three decoder inputs, timestamp ties straddling batch boundaries, self-loops, fan-in, fan-out, outputs, state buffers, parameter gradients, empty batch, original implementation parity
